To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) machine learning can be used to identify gaps in predictability of catalytic performance from experimental data; and (ii) these gaps can be filled by targeted experiments that are guided by machine learning.

we have developed a machine learning framework for predicting catalytic activity from a comprehensive water gas-shift reaction data set, and that our framework can be used to guide experiments in order to improve the prediction of catalytic performance and to identify new promising formulations.

In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a machine learning based framework for the analysis of large experimental data sets and for the design of new experiments.
developing a framework to analyze, predict, and design catalytic systems.
the development and application of machine learning methods to improve the predictability of catalytic activity and to identify new promising catalyst formulations.

our framework provides a new and powerful approach for analyzing experimental data, and for guiding the design of new experiments.
